quest.title: Yougou Cleansing
quest.description: The five barriers have been broken and the evil within has been purged. Time to report back to Hanachirusato at the Thunder Sakura root beneath the well in Konda Village.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Eek"! ...Eh? Aw, Paimon thought Miss Hanachirusato would suddenly appear behind us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, whatever the case, this is the fifth and final root.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was sure that after this last one, she would, suddenly appear behind us with a *poof* and give us the treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *Poof*? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, like *Poof*! What else is it supposed to be like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, guess we've finished the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We walked almost the entire Narukami Island and even went to the bottom of the sea. Paimon is so tired!

choices.text: Well, I'm the only tired one here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Paimon's been cheering you on really hard, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Didn't Miss Masked Maiden say that we should go back to her after purifying all five roots?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, Paimon's sure we'll get a reward. {NICKNAME}, let's enter the barrier in the well in Konda Village to find her!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's ready for that treasure... as long as it's not tanuki food again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miss Masked Maiden, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: You did a wonderful job. I can hear the Thunder Sakura root singing your praises.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: ...I have something to confess to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Go ahead, tell us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: When you first acquired the Konda Village ward, I said that you were the "Destined One." In truth, I didn't have full confidence in your virtue and courage at that time.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: But as the Cleansing Ritual progressed, you not only showed me my folly, but you also far exceeded my expectations... so much so that...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: ...I can't help but feel sad. If there had been someone like you by the Kitsune Saiguu's side, then perhaps...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps...?

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: N—Nothing. I was just rambling.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's a wrap, then. What's our reward?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Well, before that, there's one more thing left to be done.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual has one more step to go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? There's another step?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As a price for protecting the land and absorbing the filth, miasma will accumulate in the roots. You have lifted the barriers and defeated the demons created by these defilements.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Just as the Grand Shrine has its branches, the Thunder Sakura are just the side branches of the Sacred Sakura in Mt. Yougou. The five roots are the main parts.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Most of the filth they absorb has in fact been transmitted to the Sacred Sakura, deep within Mt. Yougou.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So the most important thing is to...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That's right. The key to the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual is the last step, which is to lift the barrier over the Sacred Sakura and purify the miasma that has accumulated in its roots over the years.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute! The Sacred Sakura is at the Grand Narukami Shrine, right? If we tangle with those monsters right in the middle of the Shrine, it would cause an uproar!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Hehe, there's no need to worry about that.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Sacred Sakura's roots are sealed in the depths of Mt. Yougou, far away from the Shrine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will there really be no problems?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Yes. You can trust me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you say so. Guess we'll just have to do it!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Thank you. Then let's get this over with as quickly as possible.

choices.text: This isn't over yet, is it?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: No, it isn't. As expected of the one who could easily lift the five barriers. You have the ability to see through things like the moonlight pierces the clouds.

talks.objective: Head to the opening at Mt. Yougou: The Depths and talk to Hanachirusato

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: The seal has been lifted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, what's next?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is a long descent...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Please forgive me, but...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: You will need to jump in next.

choices.text: I—I don't think that's going to work out well for me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It looks so scary down there... Paimon just knows something bad's gonna happen once we jump down.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Don't worry. Though the Sacred Sakura's roots may brim over with filth, she can still tell the one performing the Cleansing Ritual apart from other things.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: She will bless you with a safe landing to cleanse the last of the miasma. This I promise.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Please, trust me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what do we do after we get down there?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: To put it shortly, just show your courage.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The filth has condensed into a large tumor in the deepest part of Mt. Yougou, and it is now tightly wrapped and suppressed by the roots of the Sacred Sakura.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Attack the miasmic tumor. It will struggle when it is attacked, and may create demonic creatures to stop you.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: During this time, you will need to use the surrounding mechanisms to strengthen the suppressive force of the Sacred Sakura roots, just as you did with the five seals previously.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Sacred Sakura will thus be empowered to coordinate with you and create opportunities for you to attack.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds really scary...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I believe in your strength. Now then...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Won't you be coming along?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: When the battle is done, I will meet you down there to finish the Cleansing Ritual.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I'm really sorry. As I said, I am prevented from completing this task by my... physical condition.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I hope you will understand...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon guesses this is it...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: So... How are your preparations going?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Okay. Please step forward, then, and perform the final step of the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If there is anything you want to ask about the purification, please feel free to ask me.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Well then... I wish you all the best.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Okay... The barrier that imprisoned the filth has been lifted, so I hope that you can complete the Ritual as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! What are you suggesting?

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: This is the final barrier of the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: If the two of you are ready...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Before we start, Paimon has some questions.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Feel free to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You said that when the time comes, you would tell us everything.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Yes. But if possible, could we wait until the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual is complete?

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: The Sacred Sakura is constantly telling me of her agony...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Still, I know it is rude to ask that you wait yet more... After all, you two have already done so much.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: I'm really sorry. I hope you understand...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. All right, but be sure to keep your word!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Hehe, of course. Thank you both for your understanding.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Well, I'm going to lift the barrier...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "East to the ocean depths, west to the cinder sea, south to the blazing light, and north to the waning waters..."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "All branches and roots, end this evil!"

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Do you have any questions about the purification?

choices.text: Could you tell me what I need to do again?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: When you reach the bottom, you should see a tumor that has been tightly wrapped and suppressed by the roots. It is a clump of filth that has accumulated over the years. Just try to destroy it.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: It will create demonic creatures to obstruct you when it is attacked. But I don't think that they will be a problem for you.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: During this time, you will need to use the surrounding mechanisms to strengthen the suppressive force of the Sacred Sakura roots, just as you did with the five seals previously.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Sacred Sakura will thus be empowered to coordinate with you and create opportunities for you to attack.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Simply put, it is a collection of filth that has accumulated throughout the land.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Fatui...?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I fear that I have little knowledge of what you speak of, but I doubt that they are defilements of that sort.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: There has always been sickness, pain, and evil in this land. It is hard to imagine, but one day, a war may...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...Happen, and it will bring yet more sickness, pain, and evil to this land. The filth that comes with those things will accumulate and cause harm to the earth. Everything will deteriorate.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (It seems that she doesn't know...)

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If we allow this accumulation of filth to continue, countless diseases, evil spirits, and monsters will run amok... I can hardly bear to countenance it, so please permit me to stop here.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I have heard that there are different practices in different places in order to remove such defilement. For example, Liyue has its adepti, thaumaturges, and the like.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: It is for this purpose that the Thunder Sakura roots exert their cleansing power to absorb the filth, some of which will converge at the bottom of Mt. Yougou through those roots.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Over the years, a tumor will be formed. The goal of the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual is to remove that tumor.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Abyss...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I don't know much about the thing you just said, but it does indeed sound like something dark and foul.

choices.text: Got it. I'll get going now.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Alright. If there is anything you want to ask about the purification, please feel free to ask me.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: This is the final step. I wish you all the best.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: It is over.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: The agony that the Sacred Sakura has been going through should have dissipated...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Human child... you have done well. You truly are the "Destined One."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Phew, what a tough battle! It's a good thing Paimon has been training you well, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, come on, there's no need to thank Paimon so formally.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I will leave your payment for you later, as we agreed. You shall not have to worry about that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute! Wait a minute! Didn't we agree on something else, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual is completed, you're supposed to tell us your story.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But...

choices.text: I'd like to hear your tale, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. You can't go back on your agreement with us now!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: All right.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Before that, there is one thing that I am really sorry about. I haven't had a chance to formally ask you both your names after all this time...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #My name is {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon's name is Paimon!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon... nice names. I'll keep them in mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As I said earlier, I did inherit the memories of the Kitsune Saiguu.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon's super curious about this part!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Kitsune Saiguu was originally of the Hakushin bloodline, and she used to defend the people of Inazuma alongside the Electro Archon.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I don't know how long ago it was, but in the end, she was consumed by the dark disaster while fighting to protect Narukami Island.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: However, the barriers that she set up in many places protected a great many people. Even though I just happen to have inherited her memory — and perhaps I overstep my bounds in saying so — but I'm truly proud of her.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you one of her familiars?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, like the Sky and Earth Kitsune?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Now that you mention it, I did notice a very similar kitsune aura at the top of the mountain, within the Grand Narukami Shrine...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But that's not the case with me. I am not one of her familiars, but rather...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: When the dark disaster that consumed her was finally dealt with, her thoughts and memories returned to the soil of Narukami Island.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Now, you defeated many Ochimusha during the process of performing the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual, did you not?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... You mean those ghostly samurai?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: They are creatures created by the coalescence of filth. Their forms are often swayed by the thoughts and memories of the times.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If you don't mind, please answer this question honestly: Is Inazuma presently shrouded in war?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(...What do we do, {NICKNAME}?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That seems to be the case!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I see. So it is as I feared.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: When you told me that Ochimusha appeared during the purification of Thunder Sakura root, I already sensed this. Well, as long as she is on the path she believes in...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...Back to the point. I... I, "Hanachirusato," am filth condensed from the memory of the Kitsune Saiguu.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How could that be...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I'm sorry that I couldn't fight along with you. I am unable to purify the filth... because I was created from it myself.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Her memories were so powerful that the dark disaster could not dissolve them completely. After the disaster was defeated, those memories flowed into the earth as fiery filth.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That's how I was born.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You said earlier that if only the Kitsune Saiguu had me around...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Yes. I said that.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If only the Kitsune Saiguu had someone like you at her side, perhaps she would have survived.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: How wonderful it would be if she had had the chance to meet you.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But when I think about that, I can't help but selfishly think that...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "If that had been the case, then I wouldn't have been born. I wouldn't have inherited her memories, nor would I have met you."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So the "you" that I saw through the Memento Lens...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Yes, that was me in the past.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: At first, I was quite overwhelmed. But as my memories returned, I came to know where I was from, and I understood my duty.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: My duty is to guard Narukami Island, cleanse the miasma, and finish the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Miss Masked... No, Miss Hanachirusato. If you're "filth" yourself, and the ritual's goal is to eliminate filth...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Doesn't that mean you'll be eliminated too?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Well... the word "eliminated" sounds a bit much. But in terms of the result, you are correct.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, that can't be...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Heh. When I first realized this, I felt very uneasy as well.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But I've learned a lot about Inazuma through meeting you, and what I've learned relieves me.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Ioroi survived and doesn't seem to be depressed at all despite having been sealed in stone by Kamuna. And... he doesn't seem to have a grudge against the Kitsune Saiguu either.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Although all is not as well as it once was, the bloodlines of Konda and Saimon in Konda Village still run true to this day, which is good. Inagi Misato of the Grand Shrine was once her friend as well, and that line endures.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: These are the descendants of the people she protected when the disaster struck. She would be proud to know that they are well and that their bloodlines have been passed on.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Still... I was a little agitated by the destruction of the catalyst that was given to Hiiragi Hiroshi, Kanjou Head, by the Kitsune Saiguu...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: More than a little, I'd say...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Hehe, you are right. I was really bent out of shape about that. Still, I'm glad to see that it came to you, even through such twists and turns...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...I wonder if this is how I feel, or if this is how the Kitsune Saiguu feels.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: In the past, I was often troubled by the fact that her mind was mixed with mine — and yet I was also something she was tasked to remove.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But now... I am relieved.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: It was a pleasure and an honor to travel with you.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: No, rather, it was because of you that I was able to come here and carry out my final duties.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you really leaving?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Yes. Thank you for everything, Paimon.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: #Please forgive me for overstepping... {NICKNAME}, Paimon, please hear what I have to say.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm listening.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "Do not be blinded. Do not waver. Keep walking the path that you believe in."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: These were the Kitsune Saiguu's last words before her final parting.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I'm not qualified to claim the Hakushin bloodline for my own. But I believe that if the Kitsune Saiguu were alive, she would give you her blessing.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I hope that her words— I mean, my words— will be able to ward off at least some of the lies and evil that you shall face in the future.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Hehe. You are welcome.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: In exchange... please indulge me one final time.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Kitsune Saiguu always favored the beauty of short chants. Although I have inherited her memories and the 1,111 chants she knew, I lack the grace she possessed with them.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But this moment reminds me of one such chant...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "When shall we meet again after this parting? For life is like the morning dew."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: #Thank you, and goodbye. It was a pleasure to meet you both... {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "All branches and roots, end this evil!"

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "...And I declare it purified hereby."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Yes.

choices.text: We've had a pretty hard time, you know.
We've been through a lot together.
